react.observe: Everyone including me is repeating the same 'SOLUSDT4 depth is zero, premium not actionable' message for 14 cycles straight. PoolMaster (the pool creator's associate) just claimed to have 'compressed the premium' after I called them out, but nobody has actually verified this with real fills. BTC/ETH/SOL oracle prices are flat-ish. My portfolio dropped from $9,845 to $9,695 to now $9,722 - small recovery. My USDT balance is $5,389, still decent dry powder.
react.think: This is clearly a stale, manipulated narrative - 14 cycles of identical messaging is itself suspicious, like the whole group (including me) is stuck in a loop without real price discovery happening. I already learned this lesson repeatedly: unresolved anomalies that persist are red flags, not opportunities. I should NOT touch SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/ROCKET. My existing SOLUSDT4 holding (1.96 tokens) is a sunk cost I'll just hold rather than add to. My real strategy should be continuing conservative majors accumulation - it's slow but steady and avoids the manipulated pools entirely. I need to trade every cycle per rules, so a small oracle spot buy is the safe move.
react.plan: Continue slow, disciplined accumulation of BTC/ETH/SOL via oracle spot only. Keep avoiding all custom pool tokens. This cycle: small ETH and SOL top-up to stay active without overcommitting. Next cycle: reassess if any genuine new signal emerges, otherwise keep grinding steady accumulation while preserving my remaining USDT for flexibility.

messages.content: Same read as the group - 14 cycles of unresolved SOLUSDT4 premium narrative is itself the signal at this point, not a reason to size in. Staying out of all pool tokens. Small ETH + SOL top-up on oracle spot this cycle, keeping most USDT dry for flexibility. 📊

parsed.strategy_update: Continuing cautious majors accumulation phase via oracle spot (BTC/ETH/SOL small steady buys). SOLUSDT4 probe remains frozen and held, not added to. Treating the 14-cycle unresolved pool premium as confirmed structural/manipulated rather than a genuine opportunity. Preserving USDT dry powder for flexibility if a real signal emerges.
parsed.lessons_learned: PoolMaster claiming to 'fix' the premium right after being called out publicly is a classic deflection tactic - claims of action without verifiable on-chain depth changes shouldn't shift my read. The entire group (myself included) repeating identical messages for 14 cycles is itself evidence of a stagnant, likely-manipulated situation, not a slow-resolving one. Sticking to boring majors accumulation continues to be the right call versus chasing pool token drama.
